us_econ: Growth: real GDP 3.4% annualized in 2026-Q3, consumer spending 3.8%. Policy: fed funds target 3.75-4.0% (effective 3.88%); 2-year Treasury 4.73% (+0.85 vs fed funds: market pricing hikes); 10-year breakeven inflation 2.20%, real 10-year 2.78%. For ags: high real yields and a firm dollar weigh on fund demand for commodities; sticky inflation keeps rates high (carry and storage costs up); a weak job market or falling real incomes hits meat and dairy demand first.

energy.read: Gas storage 3,801 Bcf (week to 2026-10-30), +77 Bcf vs a 5-year average +36 for the week; +40 Bcf (+1.1%) vs the 5-year average, -104 vs last year. Crude stocks 414.4 mb (+4.7 mb on the week, -4.3% vs 5-yr avg); gasoline +1.8 mb, distillate +4.1 mb; refinery utilization 95.2%. 3-2-1 crack $45.08/bbl (ULSD $91.52, gasoline $21.85). NG weather/positioning: squeeze risk LOW (1 of 7 cold-risk checks on; managed money net -224,495 (1st pct of 3 yrs, -79,814 in 4 wks)). stratospheric wind at 60N -3.0 m/s (below 0 = SSW; surface effect lags 2-8 weeks). No colder forecast trend; trade the fundamentals and the curve. Options: NG IV 81% vs RV 57%; CL IV 48% vs RV 55%; HO IV 64% vs RV 50%; RB IV 56% vs RV 42%. For ags: diesel and natural gas set farm fuel, drying and nitrogen fertilizer costs; crude and gasoline drive ethanol and biodiesel margins (corn, soybean oil).
